title: 2009 AMC 8 Problem 6
statement: Steve’s empty swimming pool will hold \(24{,}000\) gallons of water when full. It will be filled by \(4\) hoses, each of which supplies \(2.5\) gallons of water per minute. How many hours will it take to fill Steve’s pool?

solutions.text:
The \(4\) hoses together fill the pool with \[2.5 \cdot 4 = 10\] gallons of water per minute.

To fill \(24{,}000\) gallons, it will take the hoses \[24{,}000 \div 10 = 2{,}400\] minutes to fill the pool.

\(2{,}400\) minutes is the same as \[2{,}400 \div 60 = 40\] hours.

Thus, A is the correct answer.
hints: First find the combined filling rate of the four hoses.
Convert minutes to hours after finding the total number of minutes.
